The '''Eternal Empire Walker''' was a two-legged combat [[Walker/Legends|walker]] model produced by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Such walkers were prominently used by Zakuul military during and after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] both in defensive capacity on their homeworld and offensive capacity elsewhere in the galaxy. [[Tyth's Gauntlet]] was a prominent combat tactic of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] that required the use of the walkers. Following the [[assault on Odessen]] and the death of Empress [[Vaylin]], the [[Eternal Alliance]] gained victory over Zakuul forces and a small margin of Eternal Empire Walkers were reappropriated by the Alliance and later used during the [[War on Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eternal Empire Walkers appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as both enemy NPCs and mount which can be used by players. One such walker is called the [[Talon of Izax]] and was deployed on the battlefield near the [[Shrine of Healing]] during the [[Invasion of Voss]].
